positions.statement: Ball's pamphlet statement lists expanding housing options so working people can afford to live in Milwaukie as a goal.
positions.excerpt: Keep Milwaukie Affordable: Expand our housing options ensuring working people can afford to live, stay, and build their future here.

source.publisher: Clackamas County Elections, Official Voters' Pamphlet (Nov 3, 2026), PDF p. 35 (printed C-34)

positions.statement: Ball's pamphlet statement lists making city finances and decisions easier to understand, and giving residents a voice in how the city grows, as a goal.
positions.excerpt: Put Transparency First: Make city finances and decisions easier to understand and more accessible while giving residents a voice in how our city grows.

source.publisher: Clackamas County Elections, Official Voters' Pamphlet (Nov 3, 2026), PDF p. 35 (printed C-34)

positions.statement: Ball's pamphlet statement lists investing in safe sidewalks, streets, parks and transit, and building a more community-centered public safety approach, as a goal.
positions.excerpt: Invest in safe, accessible sidewalks, streets, parks, transit, and public spaces while building a more community-centered public safety approach.

source.publisher: Clackamas County Elections, Official Voters' Pamphlet (Nov 3, 2026), PDF p. 35 (printed C-34)

positions.statement: Ball's pamphlet statement lists supporting small businesses and strengthening the local economy as a goal.
positions.excerpt: Support our small businesses and strengthen the local economy so residents and entrepreneurs can thrive.

source.publisher: Clackamas County Elections, Official Voters' Pamphlet (Nov 3, 2026), PDF p. 35 (printed C-34)

positions.statement: On the priorities page of Ball's campaign website, a heading states a housing goal that Milwaukie be a place residents can afford to call home.
